items.title: EDATracer: An Agentic Framework for Large-Scale EDA Artifact Analysis

items.title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs
items.excerpt: STCO adds prescribed target-time motion, inflow and forcing conditions to neural-operator backbones for time-dependent PDEs. On an immersed-boundary CFD benchmark, the authors report mean paired reductions of 31.1% in field error and 24.7% in pressure-derived load error.
